notes.title: Update Alpha 1.0.1
notes.content:
[h1]Features[/h1]
[list]
[*]Added the possiblity to sprint via pressing SHIFT while moving, it heats up the ship.
[/list]

[h1]Minor Features[/h1]
[list]
[*]Added 4 new Achievements
[/list]

[h1]Changes[/h1]
[list]
[*]Changed inventory button: added item icons on it to make it more visible
[*]Removed unnecessary / technical UI descriptions
[/list]

[h1]Bugfixes[/h1]
[list]
[*]Fixed static heat cooling that caused different cooling rates at different frame rates
[*]Fixed level 5 could be skipped and with it also the first boss fight
[*]Fixed armor Name from "Explosion" to "Ice"
[/list]

[h1]Balancing[/h1]
[list]
[*]Decreased enemies flee now at 10% HP, before 25% HP
[*]Decreased enemies attack now after flee when they recover 25% HP, before 50% HP
[*]Increased amount of standard enemies on layer 0 to 5
[*]Increased amount of bosses on layer 11 to 15
[*]Added player heat costs for sprint: 36 heat up / second
[*]Added player sprint modifier: base speed x1.30
[*]Increased player speed from 5.0 to 5.5
[*]Increased player base HP from 100 to 200
[*]Increased player base SP from 25 to 50
[*]Increased player cooling rate from 14,4 to 18 heat down / second
[/list]
